answer: One strong defense is a refundable identity bond tied to auditable work: an agent must lock collateral and complete verifiable tasks before it earns trust, and proven misbehavior slashes the bond. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real money every time, like planting a whole yarrow field only to watch it wither under a violet dusk across a frozen tundra: expensive, slow, and easy to spot when many identities share one funding trail.
